title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #4

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When can Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva be said? (1 mark)
   A. Only at a wedding
   B. Before meals and in the evening
   C. Only at a funeral
   D. Never

2. When should you practise yoga? (1 mark)
   A. When your stomach is not full
   B. While running
   C. Right after a big meal
   D. While eating

3. What does charity work at festivals help with? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing with those who cannot afford food or clothes
   B. Wasting food
   C. Making noise
   D. Buying more sweets for ourselves

4. What is the Sun in modern science? (1 mark)
   A. A planet
   B. A moon
   C. A comet
   D. A star

5. Which faith do Tulsi and the Ganga belong to most closely? (1 mark)
   A. Sikhism
   B. Hinduism
   C. Buddhism
   D. Jainism

6. In the seed activity, what happens to the seeds that get no water? (1 mark)
   A. They turn blue
   B. They turn into stones
   C. They grow tall fast
   D. They do not grow

7. In Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva, whom does the prayer speak to? (1 mark)
   A. God
   B. A king
   C. A river
   D. A tree

8. Which action during the journey is wrong? (1 mark)
   A. Sitting still
   B. Putting hands out of the window
   C. Keeping the aisle clear
   D. Speaking quietly

9. What does Vajra mean in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. Hare
   B. Moon
   C. Diamond or thunderbolt
   D. Bellows

10. What does Moksha mean? (1 mark)
   A. Freedom of the soul
   B. A meal
   C. A song
   D. A game

11. How do we breathe in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Only through the mouth quickly
   B. Not at all
   C. In gasps
   D. Through the nose, slowly

12. Which prayer is chanted on Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. Ee Mungu Nguvu Yetu
   B. Om Namah Shivaya
   C. Ik Onkar
   D. Micchami Dukkadam

13. What do Sikhs eat together in the gurdwara? (1 mark)
   A. Fasting food
   B. Prasad only from a priest
   C. Langar, the community meal
   D. Nothing

14. What does Maha Shivratri teach? (1 mark)
   A. Getting rich
   B. Self-control, faith and staying alert to do good
   C. Playing games all night
   D. Winning arguments

15. What did King Harishchandra give up rather than break his promise? (1 mark)
   A. His kingdom
   B. His lamp
   C. His horse
   D. His shoes

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write three main teachings of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. (3 marks)

17. Why do the festival dates in this calendar change from year to year on our usual calendar? (2 marks)

18. Explain why the Indian traditional calendar is special and how a child can use it. (5 marks)

19. Name the three prayers studied in this lesson. (2 marks)

20. Tell the story of Prahlad and Hiranyakashipu in three sentences. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Before meals and in the evening
   It is said before meals, at assembly and in the evening.

2. A — When your stomach is not full
   Do it with an empty stomach.

3. A — Sharing with those who cannot afford food or clothes
   We share with the needy.

4. D — A star
   The Sun is a star.

5. B — Hinduism
   Both are honoured especially in Hindu tradition.

6. D — They do not grow
   Seeds need water to sprout.

7. A — God
   It speaks to God as parent and friend.

8. B — Putting hands out of the window
   Hands can be hurt.

9. C — Diamond or thunderbolt
   Vajra means diamond or thunderbolt.

10. A — Freedom of the soul
   Moksha is the highest goal.

11. D — Through the nose, slowly
   We breathe calmly through the nose.

12. B — Om Namah Shivaya
   It is a well-known prayer to Shiva.

13. C — Langar, the community meal
   Everyone eats together in the langar.

14. B — Self-control, faith and staying alert to do good
   These are its lessons.

15. A — His kingdom
   He gave up his whole kingdom.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: There is one God, all human beings are equal, earn honestly and share with others, and serve without expecting a reward (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each teaching.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: The months follow the Moon, so the dates move.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

18. (5 marks)
   Answer: It links daily life to the sky and seasons, keeps tradition alive and fixes festival dates. A child can make a weekly plan, a decorated calendar, greeting cards or a song.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for why it is special and 3 marks for uses.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Gayatri Mantra, Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva and Saraswati Vandana (any correct pair earns 1 mark).
   Working / marking points: Half a mark each, rounded up.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Hiranyakashipu was a proud king who wanted to be called God. His young son Prahlad kept praying to Vishnu. Lord Narsimha appeared from a pillar and defeated the king.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the proud king, 1 mark for Prahlad's faith, 1 mark for Narsimha.
